In spaceflight, what was launched by ISRO on September 3, 2026?

[2026 in spaceflight / Satellite technology] On 3 September, ISRO launched EOS-05, India's first geostationary Earth observation satellite. The satellite was launched on PSLV's return-to-flight mission after the failed PSLV-C62 in January 2026.
[2026 in India / August] 21 August – Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre head Pawan Goenka announces that ISRO is going to stop making launch vehicles and it will be done by private sector.
[2026 in spaceflight / Rocket innovation] On 18 July, Skyroot Aerospace launched Vikram 1, India's first commercially built rocket, with a successful flight carrying multiple payloads to Low Earth Orbit.
[2026 in spaceflight / Indian human spaceflight program] ISRO aims to launch Gaganyaan-1, India's first uncrewed orbital test flight to support human exploration missions.
[2026 in spaceflight / Satellite technology] In 2026, NASA plans to launch LOXSAT, a cryogenic fluid management demonstration satellite mission.
